title: Exchange Note: Returned Test Strips Added to the Next Strip Refill
content:
On the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program a take-back of test strips adds its units to the refill one for one: the units of test strips the warehouse recorded as received back on the program within the last calendar month when any were received, the units authorized on a take-back of test strips issued within the last calendar month when none have yet been received, and nothing otherwise; a date falls within the last calendar month when it is later than the same calendar day one month earlier.

**Points of judgement**

- Received units come first. Once the warehouse has recorded test strips received back within the last calendar month, those received units are added, whatever was authorized.
- Authorized units count only while nothing has been received back within the last calendar month, and only for a take-back (return authorization) of test strips issued within that month.
- The units are added as whole billing units to the units the refill's strips come to.

**Input — judgement — units added (hypothetical; today is 15 August)**

| Warehouse receipts of test strips | Take-back of test strips issued | Units added |
|---|---|---|
| 3 units received on 5 August | 4 units, 20 July | 3 |
| none | 4 units, 20 July | 4 |
| none | 4 units, 16 July | 4 — later than 15 July |
| none | 4 units, 15 July | 0 — not later than 15 July |
| none | none | 0 |
